You can trim your own notification volume in your profile settings. Open **Profile → Notifications** and turn off the types you don’t need (e.g., mention, status‑change, digest). Leave the **Assignment** notifications on if you only want alerts for items assigned to you. Changes take effect immediately and only affect your account.

If you need any further help, just let us know!
